Noise/quantization ~0.005 << band 0.05. No dead zone. Therefore PI + low feedforward is sufficient; D would amplify quantization. Ki=0.01 near target (Ti~90s < tau) removes offset, Ki_far=0.002 when |err|>0.15 prevents windup during ramp, deadband 0.002 avoids quantization limit cycle. I_lim +-0.25 leaves 10x authority over FF uncertainty range 0.366-0.409. Filter Tf=12s smooths 0.005 steps without adding lag vs 155s plant. Conditional anti-windup freezes I on saturation. Output clamped to [0,0.85] to never approach 0.9 cutoff.
